full_name: Martin Harries | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2008–2009 Humanities Burkhardt Fellow New York University
bio: Martin Harries is an associate professor of English at New York University (NYU), where he teaches courses on theater, modernism, and theory.
